newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest fairly light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs 1.5 ld 64.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) compared with Wednesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were steady.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1275 lbs 105.00-106.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 101.00-102.00. Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 104.00-105.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 97.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1150 lbs few 106.00.
For the week - 22,000 Wk ago - 19800 Yr ago - 32,700 Steers and heifers - Live basis - $0.50-$1.00 lower. Carcass basis - $1.00-$2.00 lower. Confirmed - 800 Week Ago - 3,800 Year Ago - 2,600
